COLLECTION C: SYSTEMS & LEADERSHIP

The Centre of Excellence Governance System

“Good intentions do not scale; good systems do. For doing repair work, we need to do prepare work.”

ENGINEERING RIGOR IN EDUCATIONAL OPERATIONSInstitutional Record(CLM-026)

Running 18 colleges, 101 schools, and 61+ companies with more than 2,000 educators and staff requires an engineer’s mindset: define the process, assign clear ownership, measure the outcome, and review it on a fixed cadence. Dr. Arawindhan established the ACHARIYA Centre of Excellence (CoE) to ensure consistent quality across every campus, every single day.

The Five-Step Accountability Chain

1

1. Approved

Chief Mentor (Dr. J. Arawindhan Ji)

Defines and approves the concept, standard of excellence, and philosophical intent.

2

2. Enriched

Engine Team Lead

Translates the concept into detailed pedagogical methods, lesson plans, materials, and kits.

3

3. Enabled

Campus Monitor

Equips, trains, and certifies the teachers and campus leaders with required skills.

4

4. Executed

Campus Enabler (Teacher / Staff)

Delivers the active learning experience in the classroom, period by period, child by child.

5

5. Ensured

Engine Team Lead & Audit Team

Audits learning outcomes, reviews student evidence, and verifies consistency with standard.

SIX ENGINES

The Six Engines of Campus Excellence

Driving holistic quality, parent trust, and digital transformation across the ecosystem.

Student Success

Academic mastery, world records, character, and 100% learning curve.

FACULTY EVOLUTION HIERARCHYInstitutional Record(CLM-027)

Rope-In Induction & 77 ConCardios Trainings

“Change, Evolve, Transcend: Give space for participation; do not give space for resistance.”

Every educator and professional joins through the Rope-In induction (Change, Evolve, Transcend) with 3C, 4E, 5H, 6T, and 7C behavioral practices, advancing through 77 trainings organized in six developmental phases.

1. Nestling

New entrant onboarding, cultural alignment, and institutional ethics.

2. Fledgling

Basic pedagogical toolkits, classroom control, and communication skills.

3. Juvenile

Multi-intelligence lesson planning and diagnostic gap remediation.

4. Matured

Departmental leadership, mentoring junior faculty, and parent counseling.

5. Soaring

Campus headship, curriculum innovation, and research contributions.

6. WOW

Master mentors embodying the 21 levels of Airavatha consciousness.
